# Action forms scenes available for binding

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Cross-situational resolution: for every type of records and meanings, a form resolves to a meaning of a repertoire without repeats exactly when every record bearing on the form offers it and every other meaning is missing from some bearing record. For enacted scenes: from every situation whose transition record groups the two-word encoding and whose repertoire has no repeats, after every history of moves and namings, every finite encoded sequence is interpreted as the assembly of its atoms exactly when, for each word, the earlier records and the namings heard along the history, each offering what was accessible where the learner stood, separate its atom. The coordinated history (coordinated 37) is an instance; naming from one place (stationary 37) fails separation, and naming a site from where its atom is not accessible (mistimed 37) fails coverage. The specified spatial arrangement and supported movement/naming history produce the previous binding construction’s exact interpretation inputs; separate witnesses cover actual response and access, retention and timing failures.

Canonical source: [EnactedScene.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/EnactedScene.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Integer two-dimensional positions, Manhattan distance and range two, three identified operation sites, movement law, naming convention and schedule are supplied.
- The acquired grouping/binding architecture is reused; the successful history has 37 declared support units, including five consumed by movement.

Receiving and named positions are relational roles within one local arrangement. Range represents accessibility; it does not itself explain a full visual field, attention, bodies or communicative intention.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1: 16 new theorems / 29 declaration audits, with 288 inherited audits separately rebuilt; author counterreview and primary comparison including failed generalization, without a new experiment or independent acceptance.

A new input composition under a supplied schedule, not a proof of schedule formation, complete attention, perceptual categories, intention understanding or evolutionary psychology.

- Matching positions and name counts can yield inverted bindings through timing; a clear view omitting the target can mislead; access without retention does not bind, and insufficient support prevents movement or response. [EnactedScene.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/EnactedScene.lean)
- With a repeated meaning, resolution is not separation (Repeated); one record omitting the target can leave a wrong unique candidate (Omitted). [CrossSituational.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CrossSituational.lean)
